plays.desc_en: Right after level 6, KC sets up a top 2v2 as Doran returns to lane low; Yike (Wukong) joins, dashes in for damage, and despite Doran (Camille) nearly escaping with Hookshot, Yike flashes to finish him. Oner arrives and uses Nocturne's first ultimate defensively; the replay shows Yike flashing after spotting Doran's recall attempt under tower.
plays.quote: Doran, even though he's being poked ... Maybe not respecting the percentage ... for Yike to get involved.

plays.desc_en: T1 starts Grubs with Faker teleporting back to join, while KC is awkwardly positioned and Busio is separated after teleporting top; T1 secures two grubs.
plays.quote: So, the Grubs will be started, but look, ... Faker has just TP'd back in. ... KC's too awkward.

plays.desc_ko: 유충 이후 T1의 Neeko·MF 폭딜로 KC를 뒤로 밀어냄; Yike가 부쉬를 지키려 했지만 바위게를 통제할 수 없어 양보, KC 미드(kyeahoo)도 뒤로 물러남. 고립된 Busio가 위험해짐.

plays.desc_en: Canna keeps pressuring top lane as much as he can, while Doran holds on by catching the wave under tower.

plays.quote: Is the TP finally matched? ... Faker by Yeah, who using his return to ... the mid lane.

plays.desc_ko: KC가 두 번째 드래곤을 고려하고 처치; 거대한 우위의 레넥톤(Canna)이 근처에 있어 T1은 교전을 걸지 못하고 드래곤을 양보. 이후 회고: Canna를 미드로 옮겨 T1을 드래곤에서 밀어냈고, 귀환 후에도 TP를 보유한 위협만으로 T1의 견제를 막음.
plays.desc_en: KC takes the second dragon as T1, unable to fight with the hugely ahead Canna (Renekton) nearby, concedes it. In hindsight, moving Canna mid zoned T1 off the dragon, and even after his recall the threat of his TP kept T1 from contesting.
plays.quote: second drake of the game. T1 not sure if ... T1 don't want to pull the trigger. ... conceding the drake.

plays.desc_ko: KC가 Oner의 탑 위치를 핑으로 공유했지만, T1이 스왑 후 두 번째 대포 웨이브와 함께 Keria 포함 4인으로 Canna를 덮침. KC 지원이 오기 약 1초 전에 타격했고, Keria는 Rakan의 궁극기 진입을 피해 후속 플레이를 차단. 회고: T1이 맵의 강한 쪽(탑)을 처치해 Doran의 압박을 해소, 킬 스코어 1대1.
plays.desc_en: Despite KC pinging Oner's top position, T1 swaps and dives Canna with four including Keria alongside the second cannon wave, striking about a second before KC's help arrives; Keria dodges Rakan's ultimate to shut down any follow-up. T1 removes the map's strong side, relieving Doran, and kills stand at 1-1.
plays.quote: recognize the owner is on the top side ... And the swap has come through from T1 as ... KERIA THE WHOLE TIME AND NO OPPORTUNITY.

plays.quote: Boosie looking to find an ... engage but the lock up from owner is ... lethal. DOWN GOES BOOSIE BUT OWNER MIGHT

plays.quote: side. Resetting now to catch the bottom ... wave as well

plays.desc_en: As T1 clears vision, KC uses its bot push to move toward dragon, checks the bush, and kyeahoo dives in; Oner gives up his life while T1 gets the dragon after winning the smite fight against Yike.
plays.quote: The vision is being denied but KC are ... walking their way in. ... they face check that

plays.desc_en: T1 starts the dragon and Oner secures it at the last second in a tight smite fight.
plays.quote: THEY STARTED THE DRAGON. ... The smite fight so close was secured by ... owner in the final moments.

plays.desc_ko: 정글러를 잃은 뒤 T1이 재진입: Keria('Carrier')의 궁극기, Peyz가 넘어가 마무리하며 더블킬, MF 궁극기 이전에 이미 교전 종료. T1이 KC를 깔끔하게 에이스.
plays.desc_en: Down their jungler, T1 re-engages with Keria's ultimate and Peyz crossing in for a double kill, ending the fight before Miss Fortune's ultimate is even needed as T1 cleanly aces KC.
plays.quote: ultimate comes in from Carrier but Pays ... re-engage coming through. ... FINISH OFF ONE.

plays.desc_ko: 에이스 직후 Peyz가 벽을 넘으며 T1이 즉시 바론으로; Busio가 와서 지켜볼 뿐 막을 수 없음. T1이 바론 제거.
plays.desc_en: Right after the ace, Peyz hops the wall as T1 goes straight to Baron; Busio arrives but can only watch as T1 takes it.
plays.quote: over that wall and they immediately go ... for Baron. ... T1 now set to take the Baron.

plays.desc_en: KC hunts T1's Baron exit, tries to lock down Faker, and Oner falls again; Faker saves Flash to kill Busio and escape, while kyeahoo teleports back and chases with Spirit Rush, landing Charm. KC is eventually pushed back but secures two exit kills, missing a third.
plays.quote: KC might try to play for exit kills ... Owner now set to fall once again. ... HE JUST ONE TAPS BUSIO AND WANDERS HIS

plays.desc_ko: 바론 교전 이후 KC가 포탑을 확보; 해설은 KC에게 긍정적인 결말이었다고 정리.
plays.desc_en: KC secures a tower after the Baron fight, which the casters call a positive outcome for KC.
plays.quote: will secure a tower. ... the exit kills and the turrets they were

plays.desc_en: Two minutes before soul point dragon, T1 uses Doran's advantage to pressure a side lane tower.
plays.quote: Not Soul but Soul point and T1 trying to ... pressure these side lanes with the ... how many of these towers they can knock

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 붙잡힘: 백스텝 후 티버를 던졌지만 사망. T1 쪽이 다소 어수선.
plays.desc_en: Faker is caught and dies despite backstepping and throwing Tibbers, leaving T1 a bit disorganized.
plays.quote: now it's Faker who's been caught up. A ... nice back step. Manages to throw down ... the bear but will lose his life.

plays.desc_ko: 다섯 번째 드래곤: T1이 자리를 지키다 드래곤 시작, KC는 너무 빨라 포기.
plays.desc_en: T1 holds position and starts the fifth dragon, and KC gives it up as it goes down too fast.
plays.quote: Fifth dragon of the game. ... is T1 to hold position. ... Drake has started.

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 대신 KC가 미드 쪽 포탑 공략: 나머지 KC가 Canna를 위해 구역을 장악하며 마무리하게 하려 했으나, 한 대만 더 치면 되는 상황에서 실패.
plays.desc_en: Instead of the dragon, KC goes for a mid tower, zoning for Canna to finish it, but fails with just one hit left.
plays.quote: Rest of KC just zoning for K'Sante ... so he can finish off this objective. ... T1 ceded some control of mid lane

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 교전을 열고 Oner 궁극기; Keria는 잠시 밀려났지만 Caliste가 하나를 잡는 동안 Peyz가 둘, 셋째(셧다운 포함)를 잡아 T1 대승. 리플레이: Faker의 점멸 궁극기로 Canna가 먼저 쓰러졌고 Peyz가 Caliste를 세 대 만에 녹임.
plays.desc_en: Doran opens the fight and Oner ults; Keria is briefly pushed out, but while Caliste gets one kill Peyz takes a second and a third including a shutdown for a big T1 win. The replay shows Faker's Flash-Tibbers dropping Canna first and Peyz melting Caliste in three shots.
plays.quote: Doran kicking the fight off. Alti out ... from Owner. ... Keria has been zoned away.

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 T1이 미드를 밀어 포탑 하나 더 확보, Peyz가 방패를 더 노림.
plays.desc_en: After the win, T1 pushes mid to take another tower as Peyz looks for more plates.
